status: Production-handler regressions and canonical Release build/clean startup passed; client gameplay not performed.
problem: Repeated native quest criteria callbacks could increment an already-satisfied objective and queue multiple completions. The one-second unguarded AddDelayedEvent called CompleteQuest even after abandoning or immediately reaccepting the quest, resurrecting a removed acceptance or completing its replacement.
fix: Skip satisfied criteria objectives; bind completion to the original acceptance with existing AddQuestDelayedEvent; recheck CanCompleteQuest when the callback runs. The normal criteria/objective path and delay remain unchanged.

validation.details: Extracts actual new AchieveCriteriaCredit and unchanged acceptance-token helper, completion/race/prerequisite/reward handlers. Reconstructs the prior production handler by reversing only this patch and reproduces two queued completions, duplicate objective increments and abandoned status becoming COMPLETE. Tests fixed once-only credit, abandonment, reacceptance before callback, objective loss/recovery, wrong criteria ID and a non-grapple criteria quest. Map/network/storage and quest status services are fake.

limits: Only the one-second Player quest-criteria completion callback is repaired; the upstream achievement-manager100ms criteria dispatch is unchanged.
No scenario criteria or boost sequence handling was changed; no client quest UI, scenario recovery or whole quest gameplay is claimed verified.
The first fixture link failed because its inherited race declaration needed the actual Race.inc implementation; the fixture was corrected without removing production checks.
related_next: Restore the native criteria-based A Grapple a Day pickup in a separate commit.
